feature_contract.goal: On a replaced OpenXR host process, revoke the previous verified stereo/depth/WVP baseline immediately; only uncertain same-host IPC samples retain a bounded grace before fail-closed recovery.
trace_stages: x64 OpenXR host seqlock SharedPoseState hostPid/flags/heartbeat/sampleQpc
R21 Present owner tests coherent hard failures, same-host transient reads and PID changes
RuntimeEligibility stereo gate, R9 mono/stereo seed and R23 recovery warmup/color-depth baseline

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Fresh and SoftSuspend of new PID both fence old stereo/WVP/mono baseline and require a new recovery warmup.
Torn reads and same-PID zero QPC use at most 250ms grace; valid dead host, new-PID zero, invalid header, future/expired timestamps fail closed.
R21 negative/mutation models, DX9Ex Active five-job Win32 build, Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact pass on final result SHA.

feature_contract.scope_boundary: R21 host identity and IPC liveness in game Present only; no HUD/menu/world geometry, FFB, DX11, DXVK, host XR swapchain, or feature queue edits.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Source repro: coherent Fresh or SoftSuspend from a different host PID previously retained R9StereoSeeded/RuntimeEligibility stereo WVP approval; after a host restart this could replay the old host's verified stereo baseline before R23 color/depth warmup. Also hard stale evidence incorrectly shared the transient 250ms grace.
subcomponents: Fence R9 mono/stereo/backup and RuntimeEligibility stereo authority on different host PID in BOTH Fresh and SoftSuspend paths.
Distinguish torn or same-PID zero-QPC transient publications from coherent dead/stale/invalid protocol, with a strict 250ms grace and new baseline recovery.

diagnosis.root_cause: Coherent Stale and torn seqlock samples shared the same 250ms grace; an independently fresh host PID reused the old process baseline through R21HostFailClosed=false.
alternatives_rejected: Deleting grace entirely would regress observed single-frame seqlock handoffs.
Clearing only R9StereoSeeded without RuntimeEligibility::FailClosed would retain WVP injection eligibility.
Changing UI/HUD, Quest3 FOV or frame pacing timers cannot repair process ownership.
source_trace: R21 Present host status + PID fence
RuntimeEligibility FailClosed and R9 seed reset, R23 new-baseline authority
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: 11 model snapshots, 5 bounded-grace/PID transitions and destructive verifier mutations; final GitHub CI pending.
diagnosis.original_evidence: The pre-patch R21ReadHostFreshness returned Stale for torn and coherent invalid states alike; the old R21ApplyHostFailClosedAtPresent borrowed stale baseline for 250ms without checking failure kind or replacing hostPid.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R21 revokes source/eye stereo eligibility, R9 seeds and WVP injection; R23 requires a fresh two-eye color/depth validated recovery baseline before projection resumes.
